theorems.name: Submission.imrep_smul_rescale_action_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → R'.carrier = (fun x => c • x) ⁻¹' R.carrier → (∀ x, R'.mult x = R.mult (c • x)) → (∀ x, R'.orient x = R.orient (c • x)) → (∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, R'.action ω = R.action (fun y => (c⁻¹ ^ n) • ω (c⁻¹ • y))) ∧ ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R'.measure A = ENNReal.ofReal (c⁻¹ ^ n) * R.measure ((fun x => c • x) '' A)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
